# ACCIDENT @ CVPR 2026

> Zero-shot pipeline for traffic accident detection, localization and
> classification in CCTV video. Frame-difference peak detection, Farneback
> optical flow centroids and CLIP prompt matching, with no fine-tuning.
> ACCIDENT @ CVPR 2026.
